plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Task todo list: the agent keeps a live checklist for multi-step work and shows it to you as it goes.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: mem0
plugins.description: Long-term memory backed by a self-hosted mem0 server: the brain can save durable facts and recall them across conversations.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: image-gen
plugins.description: Image generation via the OpenAI Images API (gpt-image-1 by default). Generated images show directly in the chat.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: image-edit
plugins.description: Edit an existing image from a text instruction (image-to-image) via the OpenAI Images edits API. The result shows in the chat.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web research: WebSearch (Tavily) and WebFetch (fetch a page as readable text).
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: mcp
plugins.description: Bridge external MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into the agent — their tools become available to the brain.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: formatters
plugins.description: Automatically format files the assistant writes, using the formatter the project itself is set up for (prettier, biome, pint, ruff, gofmt, rustfmt, ...). A formatter only runs when its binary or config is present in the project.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: dev-commands
plugins.description: Curated developer slash-commands for the chat surfaces — /commit, /review, /test, /explain, /pr, /docs. Each is a reusable prompt macro: type it with an argument and the agent runs the workflow.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: security-scan
plugins.description: Scan code or a repo file for dangerous patterns (eval, pickle.load, shell=True, unpinned deserialization, hardcoded secrets…) before you rely on it. Advisory — reports findings, never executes anything.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: codebase
plugins.description: Semantic code index: search your repositories by MEANING, not literal text. Chunks each accessible repo, embeds every chunk with the SAME embedding model your memory uses (Settings → Memory), and stores the vectors in a private per-repo index. CodebaseSearch finds the most relevant code/docs for a natural-language query; CodebaseReindex (admin) refreshes it incrementally; CodebaseStatus reports coverage. Complements the files plugin's literal Search.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Loads markdown skills from disk and exposes them to the Elowen brain.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: msteams
plugins.description: Microsoft Teams bot: chat with Elowen in a personal chat, group chat or team channel, with slash commands, Adaptive Card pickers and a downloadable Teams app package.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram bot: chat with Elowen in a private chat, group or forum topic, with slash commands, inline keyboards and live message editing.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp bot over a paired phone: chat with Elowen from any WhatsApp conversation, with slash commands, numbered menus and a QR pairing screen in Settings.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Discord bot: chat with Elowen in a server channel, thread or DM, with slash commands, live message editing and per-role project access.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: cronjob
plugins.description: Scheduler: recurring prompts, one-shot wake-ups and shell collectors that wake the agent on a schedule, with a jobs screen in Settings.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: editor
plugins.description: Project file editor with Monaco, file management, image and Markdown previews, and read-only Git history. Disabling it removes the editor UI and makes its grandfathered project-file API unavailable while project registration and task Git history remain available.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: lsp
plugins.description: Language-server code intelligence: type-check an edit the moment it lands (LspDiagnostics), jump to a definition, find every reference, read a hover signature and list document or workspace symbols — all answered by the real language server for the file, not a text search. Elowen drives the servers it knows (TypeScript, Pyright, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, …) and can install the npm-based ones into its own prefix. Disabling it stops every language server and withdraws the tools.
plugins.author: Elowen
